drivingQuestion: How may one recite Shema while standing in water, when his heart sees his nakedness?
outcomeNote: The unit contains only the difficulty; its resolution falls outside this packet.

segments.he: וְאִם לָאו — יִתְכַּסֶּה בְּמַיִם וְיִקְרָא. וַהֲרֵי לִבּוֹ רוֹאֶה אֶת הָעֶרְוָה?
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: «And if» one calculates that he will «not» be able to ascend and cover himself with a garment in time to recite Shema, he should «cover himself in the water and recite» Shema there. The Gemara asks: How can one recite Shema with his head above water? «His heart sees» his «nakedness» as there is no barrier between them.
